orders_chain_health_observability.getter_note: Aggregates B-151 (NULL chain_id buckets) and B-152 (non-NULL chain_id <> expected_chain_id buckets); orders_total is COUNT(*) from orders.
orders_chain_health_observability.boundary_vs_b151_b152: Single overview/reconcile key; B-151/B-152 scalar legs match orders_null_chain_id_total and orders_chain_id_mismatch_total; ratios use orders_total as denominator.

governance_proposals_projection_null_fie.getter_note: TT-B152: mother-table state→chain_state null/blank; block_number→snapshot_block<=0 (NOT NULL DEFAULT 0); no tx_hash column — third bucket is operation_id IS NULL (expected before ProposalQueued; not Ethereum tx hash).
governance_proposals_projection_null_fie.boundary_vs_b149_b172: Read-only row counts on governance_proposals_projection only; does not compare chain Governor.state/proposalCount tail (B-149/B-172).

correction_executor_rows_observability.getter_note: TT-B160: COUNT(*) per table WHERE chain_id; correction_log MAX(created_at); executor_executions MAX(GREATEST(created_at, updated_at)). Read-only observability; distinct from 110-CORRECTION-EXECUTOR-CHAIN-SCOPE-DRY-RUN rollback dry-run body.

stake_lock_projection_block_lag_observab.getter_note: TT-B161: MAX(block_number) FROM investor_stake_state_events / investor_lock_state_events WHERE chain_id; lag_vs_checkpoint = indexer_checkpoint_block_number - max (signed; negative => projection tail above checkpoint). Checkpoint = process ApiMetaState.indexer_checkpoint.block_number. Read-only; NOT B-153 (event_log vs RPC chain head). NOT compound_gate.

indexer_reconcile_duration_batch_stats_o.getter_note: reconcile_core_duration_ms is wall time for db::reconcile_orders_projection_vs_orders only; batch_row_counts mirror response stats without samples.

orders_amount_chain_vs_escrow_drift_obse.boundary_vs_b155: B-155 v1 compares DB orders.amount (scaled by TT currency→decimals table) to on-chain Escrow.totalAmount() at orders.escrow_address via eth_call; does not use orders_projection row amounts.
orders_amount_chain_vs_escrow_drift_obse.boundary_vs_b168: B-168 v1 is escrow_status_chain_vs_orders_drift_observability (get_escrow_status vs orders.status coarse terminal); B-155 is amount-only and does not read escrow enum status for the marker.

region_share_snapshot_line_chain_vs_db.getter_note: Default uses only SQL aggregates on region_share_snapshot_lines (no chain RPC). Optional chain_sample reserved for future env-gated low-volume RPC.

indexer_tick_counters.getter_note: Populated after HTTP 200 from POST …/internal/indexer-tick (including no_new_blocks / awaiting_finality).

fee_router_fee_routes_vs_routed_events_d.boundary_vs_governance_fee_routes: fee_routes_desc_head matches first row of same SQL as GET /api/v1/governance/fee-routes with chain_id filter and limit=1 (block_number DESC, log_index DESC).
fee_router_fee_routes_vs_routed_events_d.boundary_vs_on_chain: Compared legs are DB-only (indexed PlatformFeeRouted projection); no eth_getLogs in this marker.

vault_forwards_vs_forwarded_events_drift.boundary_vs_governance_vault_forwards: vault_forwards_desc_head matches first row of same SQL as GET /api/v1/governance/vault-forwards with chain_id filter and limit=1 (block_number DESC, log_index DESC).
vault_forwards_vs_forwarded_events_drift.boundary_vs_on_chain: Compared legs are DB-only (indexed RegionVaultForwarded projection); no eth_getLogs in this marker.

escrow_status_chain_vs_orders_drift_obse.coarse_reconcile_fn: chain_off::reconcile_order_chain_vs_db(terminal_escrow_label, orders.status→OrderState) — terminal chain labels Completed|Refunded|Resolved|PartiallyRefunded|Slashed vs DB terminal Completed|Refunded|Slashed|PartiallyRefunded.
escrow_status_chain_vs_orders_drift_obse.boundary_vs_b155: B-155 compares orders.amount to Escrow.totalAmount() only; does not use escrow enum status for its marker.
escrow_status_chain_vs_orders_drift_obse.boundary_vs_rpc_escrow_samples: Uses the same DB row source as optional rpc_escrow_samples (list_orders_with_escrow_id_status_limit, updated_at DESC, limit 10); this marker is always computed on reconcile success without requiring body rpc_escrow_samples.
